targetPopulation: A declared, deliberately high-prevalence pool of public https finance and news sites where first-party subdomain CNAME delegation is common, each having served two successful unauthenticated automated desktop load checks during the preregistered reliability sweep, and each within the detector's 10-host CNAME lookup cap. Rates describe THIS population only and are not an estimate for the web: the pool was chosen to make the positive class reachable at a frame size that zero-censoring can survive.

design.selectionProtocol: Frame of exactly 350 cases drawn by seeded simple random sampling from a declared high-prevalence pool (finance- and news-weighted, target base rate about 0.50), every candidate having passed two pre-freeze load checks under the exact measurement condition. The pre-qualification probe is a bare load check that never evaluates the detector or records its output; a full scan before the frame is sealed would mean predictions were seen before preregistration. Sites whose visit exceeds the detector's 10-host CNAME lookup cap are excluded from the pool, so the cap is a declared population boundary rather than a hidden recall ceiling. N=350 at that base rate puts P(referencePresent < 100) near 1e-11 and leaves predictedDetected above 100 even at recall 0.70; a larger frame would lower the denominator risk it has already eliminated while raising zero-censoring risk, which compounds in N. See docs/calibration-cname-uncloaking-design.md for the arithmetic. The random seed is the SHA-256 of this study's committed preregistration.json, recorded in the frame tooling output.
design.referenceProtocol: Each labeler independently establishes ground truth WITHOUT any input produced by this scanner. Using their own browser capture of the case URL, they enumerate the hostnames under the site's registrable domain that the page caused their browser to contact, skipping only the registrable apex so the candidate boundary matches the detector's (lib/cname-uncloaking.ts cnameCloakCandidates). They resolve each candidate's CNAME chain through a resolver they name, and assert present when a chain reaches a host matched by an external, publicly published tracking-service list they pin by SHA-256; absent otherwise. A case in which any candidate could not be resolved is not determined and must not be labelled absent. The recorded DNS chains produced by this project's scanner and this project's tracker catalog are NOT admissible reference inputs: a labeler reading them would reproduce our resolver's and our catalog's errors exactly, and the study would report that agreement as accuracy. npm run calibration:cname-reference builds the worksheet; the labeler forms their own judgement and seals their own source.
design.adjudicationProtocol: Two through ten distinct GitHub actors label every case independently and blind to each other. One additional distinct actor precommits a blind tiebreaker source before acquisition. Agreements stand as final. Any disagreement is resolved by the precommitted tiebreaker alone, recorded as disagreement-resolved-by-blind-tiebreaker with the tiebreaker identity and artifact digest; no post-hoc discussion, relabeling, or majority vote occurs.

measurementCondition.interpretation: Rates are conditional on desktop visits with GPC disabled under passive consent observation with no consent action.
